parent_objective: screen whether reset delayed wrong-history zero-response and zero-action interventions change current-family L3 actions on matched-current pairs
blocked_by: M1217 pair mining passes and admits action-level history-intervention screening
supersedes: running persistent outcome intervention before action-screen admission
invalidates: claiming history causality from pair mining alone

public_gates: M1218 may run action-level history interventions only
M1218 must use M1217 matched-current pairs
M1218 must include reset_hidden wrong_matched_history delayed_history zero_current_response and zero_action_history variants
M1218 must not run outcome interventions
M1218 must not use private holdout
M1218 must not claim self-identification from action distance alone
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run outcome intervention gates
do not use hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not claim self-identification from action screen alone

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether history-only interventions change current-family L3 actions on the M1217 matched-current surface
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: action screen only; no outcome training promotion private-holdout paper-level generalization recurrent-belief or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if wrong/delayed history action signal is below threshold
stop if only zero-current-response is sensitive
stop if output artifacts are missing
fallback_plan: route to negative action-screen audit if wrong/delayed history is negative
route to persistent outcome intervention design if wrong/delayed signal is source-diverse
route to expanded surface mining if signal is source-narrow

admission_evidence: M1217 exports 1790 accepted matched-current pairs across 427 physical pairs, 4 probe seeds, 21 left steps, 12 obstacle buckets, and 3 targets
M1215 requires action-level screening before outcome intervention
M587 showed that a source-diverse surface can still produce negative wrong/delayed history action results
blocked_shortcuts: do not make paper-level or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: wrong/delayed history action signal is classified
next outcome-gate or negative-audit milestone is pre-registered

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1218 must separate wrong/delayed history effects from zero-current-response and zero-action-history controls.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Action evidence can admit outcome gates but cannot prove self-identification by itself.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If wrong/delayed history is negative, record current-feedback-only or action-history-only evidence and route to audit instead of outcome rollout.
allowed_claims: action-level history intervention sensitivity or negative result
no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: On the M1217 current-family matched-current surface, wrong or delayed recurrent history will produce measurable action changes beyond zero-current-response and zero-action controls.
success_criteria: wrong_matched_history or delayed_history action_distance_mean >= 0.01 on at least one checkpoint-target group
wrong_matched_history or delayed_history above_threshold_count >= 16 on at least one checkpoint-target group with threshold 0.02
zero_current_response and zero_action_history positive controls are reported
no outcome intervention, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, profile tuning, or actor-input contract expansion occurs
next outcome-gate or negative-audit milestone is selected
failure_criteria: only zero-current-response is action-sensitive and wrong/delayed history is not
self-identification is claimed from action distance

commands.name: run_current_family_history_action_screen
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.matched_history_intervention_gate --checkpoint-policy l3_s111600=runs/m1212_corrected_profile_repeat/profile_runs/L3_online_gru/seed_111600/checkpoint.pt --checkpoint-policy l3_s111601=runs/m1212_corrected_profile_repeat/profile_runs/L3_online_gru/seed_111601/checkpoint.pt --checkpoint-policy l3_s111602=runs/m1212_corrected_profile_repeat/profile_runs/L3_online_gru/seed_111602/checkpoint.pt --env-config configs/paper_route_corrected_profiles/m1207_l3_online_gru.json --pairs-csv runs/m1217_current_family_matched_current_export/matched_pairs.csv --delay-steps 2 --min-action-distance 0.02 --max-pairs-per-checkpoint-target 120 --pair-label-mode matching --device cpu --run-dir runs/m1218_current_family_history_action_screen

decision_rule: M1218 admits outcome intervention only if wrong or delayed history has source-diverse action sensitivity; otherwise it must route to a negative audit.
